opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career; projects must fulfil three funding priorities (creation/performance/promotion of outstanding new music, developing UK music creators' potential, reaching audiences).
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different career stages with grants of up to £5,000. Round 2 opened 17 August 2026 and is open until 7 September 2026.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists/bands looking to break through to the next level of their careers.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK-based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers, supporting recording, touring and marketing. Run by PRS Foundation in partnership with PPL, Creative Wales and Arts Council of Northern Ireland. Next round opens 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, plus future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists/bands outside London who face additional barriers based on location, with financial support of up to £5k. In partnership with PRS Foundation, PPL, MusicFutures, Liverpool City Region Music Board and others. Next round opens 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Tees Valley, plus future industry professionals based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists/bands outside London who face additional barriers based on location, with financial support of up to £5k. In partnership with PRS Foundation, PPL, Sonic Futures, Tees Valley Combined Authority and UK Government. Next round opens 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non-binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non-binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different career stages. In 2026 there will be one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026 while the programme is being developed; open date and deadline TBC.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)

deadlines.raw: Rolling deadlines; SXSW 2026 deadline now closed

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing events. Rolling deadlines; SXSW 2026 deadline has closed.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for composers with a strong track record, giving direct access to funding at pivotal career stages. Supports up to 15 composers per year with a contribution of up to £8,000-£15,000 for activities such as recordings, promotion/performance of existing works, international co-commissions, residencies, etc. Next round opens 14 September 2026.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000-£10,000. Next round opens 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career independent promoters across England.
opportunities.summary: Recognises the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, offering grant funding and capacity building support to bolster local, regional and national ecosystems. Grants of up to £3,500 for booking, programming and promotion of gigs, capacity building, and related costs. Round 17 is open with a deadline of 3 September 2026. Managed by PRS Foundation and supported by Arts Council England and DCMS.
